TYPE DEX · ALL 18 TYPES

Pokémon types: all 18 strengths & weaknesses

Each of the 18 types has its own matchup DNA: what does it hit for double, what hits it for double, and where does everything bounce off? This overview computes every strength, weakness and resistance live from the official type chart. Jump into the type you're looking for.
